## Biography & Summary
Salman Toha is a Frontend Developer at Pixelora Studio (Betopia Group) and a Full Stack & DevOps enthusiast from Dhaka, Bangladesh. He crafts resilient web applications, custom self-hosted server infrastructure (Docker, Linux VPS, Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnels, Tailscale, ZeroTier), and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. He is completing his final year in BSc in Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University.
